cards.example_en: We flew a kite on the beach.
cards.example_zh: 我们在海滩上放风筝。

cards.example_en: Tom hurt his knee during football practice yesterday afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 昨天下午足球训练时，汤姆伤到了膝盖。

cards.example_en: Use this knife to slice the apples for the fruit salad.
cards.example_zh: 用这把刀把苹果切成片，做水果沙拉。

cards.example_en: Knock on the office door before you go inside.
cards.example_zh: 进办公室之前要先敲门。

cards.example_en: I know a safe path to the nearest bus stop.
cards.example_zh: 我知道一条通往最近公交站的安全小路。

cards.example_en: Her knowledge of maps helped the group finish the geography task.
cards.example_zh: 她的地图知识帮助小组完成了地理任务。

cards.example_en: He practises kung fu twice a week.
cards.example_zh: 他每周练两次功夫。

cards.example_en: Don't run in the science lab.
cards.example_zh: 在科学实验室里不要跑。

cards.example_en: A lady on the bus helped my grandma carry her bags.
cards.example_zh: 公交车上一位女士帮我奶奶拎包。

cards.example_en: We swam in the lake until the sun dropped behind the hills.
cards.example_zh: 我们在湖里游泳，直到太阳落到山后面。

cards.example_en: The lamp on the desk is still on.
cards.example_zh: 书桌上的灯还亮着。

cards.example_en: This flat land is used for growing wheat and corn.
cards.example_zh: 这片平坦的土地用来种小麦和玉米。

cards.example_en: The landscape in the north is beautiful.
cards.example_zh: 北部的风景很美。

cards.example_en: Sign language helped us talk with the new student.
cards.example_zh: 手语帮我们和新来的同学交流。

cards.example_en: A red lantern hung by the door.
cards.example_zh: 门边挂着一盏红灯笼。

cards.example_en: She typed the report on her laptop.
cards.example_zh: 她在笔记本电脑上打报告。

cards.example_en: A large dog waited outside the bakery for its owner.
cards.example_zh: 一只大狗在面包店外面等它的主人。

cards.example_en: Last night I watched a funny film.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚我看了一部有趣的电影。

cards.example_en: She was late for the first lesson.
cards.example_zh: 她第一节课迟到了。

cards.example_en: I will call you later this evening.
cards.example_zh: 今晚晚些时候我给你打电话。

cards.example_en: We laugh at funny cartoons during the lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 午休时我们看着搞笑卡通，忍不住大笑。

cards.example_en: The traffic law requires bike lights after dark in our city.
cards.example_zh: 交通法规定，在我们城里天黑后骑车必须亮灯。

cards.example_en: Our neighbour works as a lawyer in the city court.
cards.example_zh: 我们的邻居在市法院当律师。

cards.example_en: Lay the map flat on the desk so everyone can see it.
cards.example_zh: 把地图平铺在书桌上，好让每个人都能看见。

cards.example_en: Don't be lazy about reviewing old words.
cards.example_zh: 复习旧词不要偷懒。

cards.example_en: Our captain will lead the team onto the field.
cards.example_zh: 队长会带领球队走上球场。

cards.example_en: I pressed a red leaf inside my diary from the hike.
cards.example_zh: 我把远足时捡的一片红叶夹进了日记。

cards.example_en: Children learn to ride bikes on the park path.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在公园的小路上学骑自行车。

cards.example_en: At least try to answer one question.
cards.example_zh: 至少试着回答一个问题。

cards.example_en: We leave the classroom when the bell rings.
cards.example_zh: 铃声一响，我们就离开教室。

cards.example_en: Keep to the left when you cycle through the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 骑车进校门时请靠左边走。

cards.example_en: He wrapped a bandage around his leg after the fall.
cards.example_zh: 摔倒之后，他在腿上缠了绷带。

cards.example_en: I squeezed a lemon over the fish Mum grilled for lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我在妈妈午饭烤的鱼上挤了一个柠檬。

cards.example_en: Can you lend me a pencil for the history quiz?
cards.example_zh: 历史小测时，你能借我一支铅笔吗？

cards.example_en: I drink less juice than before.
cards.example_zh: 我喝的果汁比以前少了。

cards.example_en: My violin lesson was moved to Wednesday after school.
cards.example_zh: 我的小提琴课改到了星期三放学以后。

cards.example_en: Let me help you with that box.
cards.example_zh: 让我帮你拿那个箱子。

cards.example_en: The letter from my pen friend arrived on a rainy day.
cards.example_zh: 笔友的信在一个下雨天送到了。

cards.example_en: Her English level rose after she joined the reading club.
cards.example_zh: 她加入阅读社团之后，英语水平提高了。

cards.example_en: The library is quiet after school.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆放学后很安静。

cards.example_en: Lie on the sofa for a while if you feel dizzy.
cards.example_zh: 如果觉得头晕，就在沙发上躺一会儿。

cards.example_en: Village life moves slowly, and neighbours still share vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 乡村生活节奏很慢，邻居们仍会分享蔬菜。

cards.example_en: We took the lift up to the fifth floor.
cards.example_zh: 我们乘电梯上了五楼。

cards.example_en: Early light came through the curtains and woke the baby.
cards.example_zh: 清晨的光透过窗帘，把宝宝弄醒了。

cards.example_en: Lightning flashed across the sky.
cards.example_zh: 闪电划过天空。

cards.example_en: I like reading after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我晚饭后喜欢看书。

cards.example_en: Rain is likely this afternoon, so take a coat.
cards.example_zh: 今天下午很可能下雨，所以带件外套。

cards.example_en: Draw a straight line under the title of your essay.
cards.example_zh: 在作文标题下面画一条直线。

cards.example_en: The lion slept in the shade.
cards.example_zh: 狮子在阴凉处睡觉。

cards.example_en: Dad read the list aloud while we packed the picnic basket.
cards.example_zh: 我们装野餐篮时，爸爸大声念着清单。

word.example_en: Do not be late for the morning meeting.
Sooner or later, you will meet a kind teacher.
word.example_zh: 你迟早会遇到一位好老师。

word.example_en: It is unkind to laugh at mistakes.
A small leak can lead to a big problem.
word.example_zh: 小裂缝可能导致大问题。

word.example_en: We can learn from our mistakes.
word.example_zh: 我们可以从错误中学习。

word.example_en: The trip takes at least two hours.
They leave for Nanjing tomorrow morning.
word.example_zh: 他们明天早上动身去南京。

word.example_en: The bank is on the left.
The book costs less than fifteen yuan.
The two bags are more or less the same.
We have a lesson at half past two.
I will not let down my team.
My uncle can give me a lift to school.
word.example_zh: 叔叔可以让我搭车去学校。

word.example_en: I would like to order a bowl of noodles.
